selected_product.product_title: Editable 30-Week Wedding Planner & Timeline Checklist Bundle — Fillable PDF + Excel/Google Sheets
selected_product.product_summary: A ready-to-use, editable 30-week wedding planner bundle providing a clear timeline (monthly → weekly → day), printable checklists, vendor & payments tracker, and a simple budget snapshot. Delivered as a fillable PDF and an editable spreadsheet (Excel + Google Sheets instructions) with an example-filled timeline to speed customization.
selected_product.buyer_problem: Engaged couples feel overwhelmed by timeline uncertainty and scattered to-do lists; they need a single, editable, step-by-step schedule plus consolidated vendor and budget trackers they can customize and print.
selected_product.solution_promise: Deliver a compact, editable planner that converts wedding planning uncertainty into a week-by-week action plan: 30-week timeline breakdown, reusable weekly/monthly checklist pages, vendor contact & payment tracking, and a budget snapshot — all editable and print-ready so buyers can customize immediately.
selected_product.packaging_strategy: Produce a compact, review-ready package that contains both editable source files and print-ready exports. Primary editable source: a master .xlsx spreadsheet with named tabs and formulas. Primary printable: a fillable PDF exported from the same template. Include an example-filled timeline PDF, clear buyer-facing instructions, an included-files manifest, Etsy listing drafts, and a preview plan. Deliver as a deterministic folder structure (/run_{run_id}/product/assets and /package/final_bundle.zip). Provide a Google Sheets setup guide (copy-paste steps and share settings) rather than a live link to avoid permissions issues. Final bundle ZIP contains: /editable/ (XLSX + template), /printable/ (fillable PDF + example PDF), /docs/ (how_to_use.md, included_files.md, key_benefits.md), /listing/ (etsy_title.txt, etsy_description.md, etsy_tags.txt), /preview/ (preview_plan.md, preview_assets_manifest.json), and final_manifest.json.

listing.title: Editable 30-Week Wedding Planner & Timeline Checklist Bundle — Fillable PDF + Excel/Google Sheets
listing.description:
Etsy title
Editable 30-Week Wedding Planner & Timeline Checklist Bundle — Fillable PDF + Excel/Google Sheets

Etsy description
Get a single, editable wedding planning system that turns overwhelm into a clear week-by-week action plan. This compact bundle gives you a 30-week timeline (monthly → weekly → day), printable checklists, a vendor & payments tracker, and a simple budget snapshot — delivered as a fillable PDF and an editable spreadsheet so you can customize and print immediately.

Why this bundle?
- Problem it solves: If your planning feels scattered, this bundle gives a single, editable schedule plus consolidated vendor and budget trackers so nothing falls through the cracks.
- Promise: A ready-to-use 30-week timeline, reusable checklist pages, vendor contact & payment tracking, and a budget snapshot — all editable and print-ready.

What’s included (final ZIP package)
All files are provided inside editable-30-week-wedding-planner-bundle.zip
- /editable/
  - 30-week-wedding-planner-template.xlsx — master spreadsheet (named tabs + formulas)
- /printable/
  - 30-week-wedding-planner-fillable.pdf — main fillable & printable planner (fillable fields)
  - example-filled-30-week-timeline.pdf — example-filled timeline to speed customization
  - vendor-payments-tracker.pdf — printable vendor & payments tracker
- /docs/
  - how_to_use.md — step-by-step buyer instructions
  - included_files.md — manifest of files in the bundle
  - key_benefits.md — quick benefit summary
- /listing/
  - etsy_title.txt
  - etsy_description.md
  - etsy_tags.txt
- /preview/
  - preview_plan.md
  - preview_assets_manifest.json
- final_manifest.json — package manifest and delivery summary

Key features
- Clear 30-week timeline: month-by-month down to weekly and day tasks.
- Editable master spreadsheet: .xlsx file with named tabs and formulas so you can adapt dates, tasks, and vendor rows.
- Fillable PDF: complete and print checklists straight from the PDF (fillable fields).
- Example-filled timeline: a ready example you can adapt to your schedule fast.
- Vendor & payments tracker: track contacts, due dates, deposits and outstanding balances.
- Simple budget snapshot: quick view to keep major costs in check.
- Google Sheets friendly: step-by-step Google Sheets setup instructions included so you can copy the template into Google Drive (no live link provided).

How it works (quick)
1. Download the ZIP after purchase.
2. Open the PDF in Acrobat Reader or another PDF reader that supports fillable forms to type and print.
3. Open the .xlsx in Excel (desktop) to edit formulas and tabs. Use the included google-sheets-setup.txt to copy the spreadsheet into Google Sheets if you prefer cloud editing.
4. Use the example-filled timeline PDF to jump-start your planning — then export or print checklist pages as needed.

File formats & compatibility
- Fillable PDF — works with Adobe Acrobat Reader and other PDF readers that support form fields.
- Editable spreadsheet — .xlsx (Microsoft Excel). Google Sheets setup guide included for cloud use.
- Text/Markdown docs — simple instructions and manifests you can open in any text editor.

Printing tips
- Print planner pages on standard A4 or US Letter.
- For ongoing use, print only the checklist pages you need each week.
- If printing vendor/payment tracker, consider 2-sided printing to save paper.

License & usage
- Personal use only (wedding planning for you or immediate family). Reselling or redistributing the files is not permitted. Contact me if you need a commercial or multi-use license.

Instant Download & Support
- This is a digital instant-download product. No physical item will be shipped.
- After purchase you’ll receive the ZIP file with everything described above.
- Questions or need help with the Google Sheets setup? Message me — I’ll reply within 24 hours.

Call to action
Ready to stop guessing and start doing? Add this Editable 30-Week Wedding Planner & Timeline Checklist Bundle to your cart and get your planning on a steady weekly schedule today.

Suggested Etsy tags (for listing)
wedding planner, wedding timeline, editable planner, fillable pdf, wedding checklist, vendor tracker, wedding budget, 30 week timeline, excel template, google sheets, printable planner, bridal planning, wedding organizer

If you want, I can also produce a shorter version of this description optimized for mobile viewers or provide alternative tag sets for different search focuses (budget, DIY, or destination weddings).

findings:
Summary
- I reviewed the generated product artifacts against the selected product: "Editable 30-Week Wedding Planner & Timeline Checklist Bundle — Fillable PDF + Excel/Google Sheets" and the project packaging strategy.
- Overall product concept and required content items were produced (title, instructions, included-files, Etsy copy, preview plan, manifest). However several technical and quality risks block this run from being considered review-ready/publishable.

Key findings (what matches)
- All planned buyer-facing artifacts are present in the generated-artifact manifest (main fillable PDF, editable spreadsheet master, example-filled timeline, vendor tracker PDF, Google Sheets setup instructions, how_to_use, included_files.md, key_benefits.md, Etsy title/description/tags, preview manifest, final_manifest, final bundle).
- Listing and buyer-facing text files were created (etsy_title.txt, etsy_description.md, etsy_tags.txt).
- Product files and docs exist in the run output (data/runs/run_wedding_checklists/...), so the pipeline produced artifacts and a final manifest.

Major issues and quality/technical risks (must fix)
1. file-format placeholders instead of real exports
   - Several “binary” outputs are delivered as markdown/text stubs, e.g.:
     - 30-week-wedding-planner-fillable.pdf → 30-week-wedding-planner-fillable.pdf.md
     - 30-week-wedding-planner-template.xlsx → .txt wrapper
     - example-filled-30-week-timeline.pdf → .md
     - vendor-payments-tracker.pdf → .md
     - editable-30-week-wedding-planner-bundle.zip → .md
   - Risk: buyers will not receive real PDFs/XLSX/ZIP. The build likely exported content as text placeholders instead of producing binary files. This must be corrected before packaging.

2. package folder structure mismatch / determinism risk
   - Packaging strategy requires deterministic structure (e.g. /run_{run_id}/product/assets and /package/final_bundle.zip). Generated paths are under data/runs/run_wedding_checklists/..., not matching the specified target layout. Ensure final bundle zip contains the required layout and that final_manifest.json reflects the exact zip contents.

3. spreadsheet compatibility & formula risk
   - The product promise depends on an editable master .xlsx with named tabs and formulas. Risks to verify:
     - Excel formulas that are incompatible with Google Sheets (e.g., XLOOKUP vs VLOOKUP, structured table formulas, macros).
     - Named ranges and sheet names must map correctly to the exported fillable PDF example (if any auto-population is expected).
     - Named tabs must exist and be documented in how_to_use.md and preview notes.
   - Action: open the .xlsx in Excel and import into Google Sheets to test formula compatibility and adjust formulas to cross-platform-safe functions where required.

4. fillable PDF functionality and print readiness
   - The fillable PDF must:
     - contain real form fields (fillable in common readers),
     - have clear print margins and be layout-tested for A4 and US Letter, or state which size is included.
   - Risk: PDF exported from spreadsheet or layout tool might be non-fillable or poorly formatted for print.

5. included_files and final_manifest alignment
   - Included_files.md must match the actual files in the ZIP exactly (names, paths, sizes). Because the binary files are missing, the included_files list likely does not reflect final ZIP contents. This must be reconciled.

6. Google Sheets setup instructions clarity
   - The buyer needs clear, copy-to-drive instructions (no live links). Risk: ambiguous steps will cause support questions and refunds. Verify instructions include copy steps, share settings, and notes about formula compatibility, locale, and potential permission steps.

7. PII / example data risk
   - Example-filled timeline PDF must not include real personal contact details (real vendors/real names/emails). If used, replace with clearly fictional placeholders.

8. missing buyer legal/usage info (recommended)
   - No license or usage terms file mentioned. Recommend adding a simple license / permitted-use note (e.g., personal use / single-event commercial allowed/not allowed) to avoid buyer confusion or disputes.

AI-quality checks (content consistency)
- Product promise, summary, and planned contents align with the buyer problem and the selected ProductType (TEMPLATE_BUNDLE).
- Etsy copy and key benefits files exist, but I did not inspect internal wording; they need final read-through to ensure tone, accuracy, and consistent claims (e.g., “fillable PDF + Excel + Google Sheets” must be true).
- The Google Sheets guide is present (good), but must be tested for clarity.

Recommended fixes (priority order)
1. Replace placeholders with real binary files (blocking)
   - Export/produce:
     - 30-week-wedding-planner-fillable.pdf (real fillable PDF)
     - 30-week-wedding-planner-template.xlsx (true xlsx with named tabs, formulas)
     - example-filled-30-week-timeline.pdf (real PDF showing an example)
     - vendor-payments-tracker.pdf (print-ready vendor tracker)
     - editable-30-week-wedding-planner-bundle.zip (final zip including the folder structure)
   - Verify file sizes >0 and openable in standard apps.

2. Ensure final ZIP contains required deterministic structure
   - Create /run_{run_id}/product/assets (with /editable/ /printable/ /docs/ /listing/ /preview/) and /package/final_bundle.zip per packaging strategy.
   - Update final_manifest.json and included_files.md to match exact ZIP contents (file names and paths).

3. Technical verification of spreadsheet
   - Verify sheet names and named ranges exist as documented.
   - Test key formulas in Excel and Google Sheets; replace any incompatible functions or include separate instructions/alternate formulas.
   - Check that the example-filled timeline cells show realistic auto-population or instructions for customising.

4. Verify fillable PDF
   - Confirm PDF form fields are interactive in Adobe Reader, macOS Preview, and common mobile PDF readers.
   - Test printing and alignment on A4 and US Letter (or state which is included).

5. Improve buyer docs & safety
   - Add a small LICENSE.txt or terms.md (usage/redistribution guidance).
   - Ensure how_to_use.md includes a brief troubleshooting FAQ and link to contact support (or note for Etsy conversation).
   - In Google Sheets setup guide, include exact copy steps and recommended share settings and note on locale differences that can change date/number formats.

6. Check PII in example files
   - If the example timeline includes real contact info, remove or replace with placeholders.

7. Final AI QA pass
   - After corrections, run a quick AI QA to ensure:
     - Title, product summary, Etsy description, instructions and included_files are consistent in claims.
     - No contradictions (for example, claim of “fillable PDF” must be true).

Suggested verification checklist for the next run (concrete tests)
- [ ] Open the .xlsx in Excel and verify:
  - named tabs: Timeline_30weeks, Weekly_Checklist, Daily_Checklist, Vendor_Tracker, Budget_Snapshot (or whatever names used)
  - formulas work and no #NAME errors
  - filters/sort and protection (if used) behave as expected
- [ ] Open the .xlsx in Google Sheets (after following google-sheets-setup.txt) and verify formulas and layout
- [ ] Open fillable PDF and:
  - confirm input fields accept typing and save
  - confirm print layout correct for included paper size
- [ ] Compare included_files.md with actual ZIP contents byte-for-byte
- [ ] Validate preview assets manifest and preview_plan.md reflect what buyers will see in the Etsy preview images
- [ ] Confirm final_bundle.zip contains the deterministic folder structure required

Final recommendation / QA status
- AI QA status: FAIL (content-level concerns are moderate but acceptable), BUT the primary blockers are technical: missing/placeholder binary files and packaging structure mismatch. The product concept, content files, and listing copy scaffolding look correct and consistent, so once the technical fixes above are done this run can pass AI QA.
- Next step: regenerate the binary artifacts and repackage as specified; then re-run AI QA and technical QA checklists above before human final review.

If you want, I can:
- produce a prioritized step-by-step remediation plan (detailed commands and checks to create the actual files and ZIP layout), or
- generate a short checklist text you can hand to the technical build step (e.g., export settings for PDF and Excel compatibility notes).

artifact_plan.purpose: Primary printable, fillable planner containing 30-week timeline overview, monthly pages, weekly checklist pages and single-day checklist sections; optimized for A4 and US Letter.
artifact_plan.generation_instructions: Create a print-ready, fillable PDF with named form fields. Include: cover/title page, key dates & contacts, 30-week timeline overview (rows per week with 3–6 action slots), monthly overview pages (month name header + top 4–5 goals), weekly checklist pages (repeatable template), and a single-page printable vendor contact & payments tracker and budget snapshot. Use clear typography, adequate margins for printing, 1–2 accent colors, and export as both A4 and US Letter. Ensure field names match spreadsheet columns where applicable.

artifact_plan.purpose: Master editable source spreadsheet with tabs for timeline, monthly checklist, weekly checklist, vendor tracker, budget snapshot, and example filled data.
artifact_plan.generation_instructions: Produce a single .xlsx file with these tabs: '30-Week Timeline' (auto-calc week numbers/dates from wedding date input, columns: week_no, start_date, end_date, key_tasks, priority), 'Monthly Overview' (month name, top goals), 'Weekly Checklist' (repeating template with checkboxes/status column), 'Vendors' (vendor, contact, contract signed Y/N, deposit, balance, due date), 'Budget' (category, budgeted, actual, remaining formulas), 'Example Filled' (sample data showing a realistic timeline). Add simple formulas (SUM for budget, conditional formatting for overdue payments), dropdowns for status, and comments with usage tips. Use clean column names to map to PDF fields.

artifact_plan.purpose: Step-by-step instructions for buyer to create a Google Sheets copy from the XLSX and set sharing permissions; includes shorthand for importing to Google Drive and recommended view/edit settings.
artifact_plan.generation_instructions: Write concise, numbered steps: how to upload the XLSX to Google Drive, open with Google Sheets, make a copy, set drop-down/checkbox equivalents, and enable offline editing. Provide troubleshooting tips (date issues, formula compatibility) and recommended folder organization. Include a short note: 'If you prefer, reply for a personalized Google Sheets share for an additional service.'

artifact_plan.purpose: Demonstration file showing a realistic, example-filled timeline so buyers can see how to use the template and what a completed schedule looks like.
artifact_plan.generation_instructions: Populate the template with realistic sample entries (vendor booking, dress fittings, invites timeline, payment milestones). Ensure sample dates correspond to a hypothetical wedding date 30 weeks out. Emphasize clarity and show how weekly tasks roll into monthly goals.

artifact_plan.purpose: Printable vendor contact & payments tracker derived from spreadsheet for quick physical reference at meetings.
